title: GUTI reallocation initiation by the network

entities.name: GUTI reallocation procedure
entities.description: Network-initiated procedure where the MME assigns a new GUTI to the UE. The MME sends a GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND message and starts timer T3450.

entities.name: GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND
entities.description: Message sent by the MME to initiate GUTI reallocation. Contains the new GUTI and optional elements like TAI list, DCN-ID, or UE radio capability information.

entities.name: GUTI REALLOCATION COMPLETE
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to the MME to confirm successful GUTI reallocation.

entities.name: GUTI
entities.description: Globally Unique Temporary Identity assigned to the UE. Mandatory IE in GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND message.

entities.name: TAI list
entities.description: Tracking Area Identity list. Optional IE in GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND message.

entities.name: DCN-ID
entities.description: Dedicated Core Network Identifier. Optional IE in GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND message.

entities.name: UE radio capability ID deletion indication
entities.description: Indication to delete stored UE radio capability ID. Optional IE in GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND message for WB-S1 mode when UE supports RACS.

entities.name: UE radio capability ID
entities.description: UE radio capability identifier. Optional IE in GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND message for WB-S1 mode when UE supports RACS.

entities.name: T3450
entities.description: Timer started by the MME when sending GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND. Stopped upon receipt of GUTI REALLOCATION COMPLETE.

relations.description: GUTI reallocation procedure includes sending GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND message.
GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND message contains the GUTI information element.
GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND message may contain the TAI list information element.
GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND message may contain the DCN-ID information element.
GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND message may contain UE radio capability ID deletion indication in WB-S1 mode with RACS support.
GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND message may contain UE radio capability ID in WB-S1 mode with RACS support.
GUTI reallocation procedure starts timer T3450 when initiating the procedure.
Receipt of GUTI REALLOCATION COMPLETE message stops timer T3450.
